content.text: No non-solicit or no-hire restriction binding Meridian exists anywhere in the agreement, and § 12.3 affirmatively confirms it.

input.quote: Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce", "employ" and "recruit" return no personnel-restriction binding Meridian; § 30.1 is a standard independent-contractor clause with no hiring restriction. § 12.3 goes further and expressly records that Customer has given no no-hire commitment and remains free to hire anyone responding to general recruitment. This matches the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so no redline is warranted — the clause operates in our favour.
